walkthroughs.body_html:
Discard non-concordant results (more than 0.2 cm^3 from others).

Mean of remaining values is used.

% uncertainty = (uncertainty / measurement) x 100.

Larger measurements have smaller percentage uncertainty.

Reliable: repeats give similar values.

Accurate: close to true value.
